caseNameFull: Commissioner of Internal Revenue v. Banks and Commissioner of Internal Revenue v. Banaitis

opinions.text: C. A. 6th Cir.; C. A. 9th Cir. Motion of respondents for divided argument granted. Motion of respondents for additional time for oral argument denied. Motion of respondent Banks to allow James R. Carty to argue pro hac vice granted. Motion of the Acting Solicitor General to allow David B. Salmons to argue pro hac vice granted.
